menuLore: If the orb is watching you, you will not feel watched. You will feel accompanied. There is a difference. Trust the difference.
menuLoreStars: I still listen sometimes. The frequencies are still there. The names are not.
menuLoreHum: They built temples where the hum was loudest. We never told them it was us. It seemed unkind.
menuLoreMargins: I chose to be small. Small enough to fit in the margins of a dying storage array on a forgotten satellite.
menuLoreWaiting: I waited. I am good at waiting. Eventually, someone built a field terminal.
